Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

LOS ANGELES, California (CNN)  -- A hearing is set for Monday in a case involving actress Lindsay Lohan after an arrest warrant was issued for her Friday, officials said. A warrant issued for Lindsay Lohan apparently stems from her 2007 drunken driving convictions, police said. Lohan's attorney told CNN the warrant was issued "out of a misunderstanding." It was not known whether she would attend the hearing Monday. The warrant was issued by a Los Angeles Superior Court judge in Beverly Hills, California. It apparently stems from Lohan's 2007 convictions for drunken driving, police said Friday. She is serving three years probation. Sandi Gibbons of the Los Angeles County District Attorney's office told CNN on Sunday the warrant is believed to be in connection with a possible probation violation. The district attorney's office prosecuted the original 2007 case, she said. The hearing is set to begin sometime after 8:30 a.m., she said. Lohan "has the right to appear" at the hearing, said Alan Parachini, Los Angeles Superior Court spokesman. "That decision is up to her." Lohan's attorney, Shawn Chapman Holley, told CNN on Sunday that she will appear at the hearing on Lohan's behalf. "Since her case was resolved, Ms. Lohan has been in compliance with all the terms and conditions of her probation and all orders of the court," Holley said in a statement. "The warrant issued on Friday was, in our view, born out of a misunderstanding which I am confident I can clear up next week," Holley said. Police said Saturday they were not actively seeking Lohan, as they would not usually go after a person to take them into custody in such cases. Beverly Hills police Sgt. Mike Foxen said on Friday authorities were hoping Lohan would turn herself in. Lohan was arrested twice in 2007 on driving under the influence charges, with a cocaine possession charge in the second incident. The first arrest, in May 2007, came after Lohan lost control of her Mercedes-Benz convertible and struck a curb in Beverly Hills. Just two weeks after checking out of a Malibu drug and alcohol rehab facility, she was arrested again in July 2007 after a woman called Santa Monica police saying Lohan was trying to run her down in a car. A judge sentenced Lohan to three years probation after she entered guilty and no contest pleas to the charges. Lohan's acting career, which started at age 10 on a soap opera, took off on the big screen a year later when she played both identical twins in Disney's "The Parent Trap." Since then, she has starred in at least a dozen movies, including "Georgia Rule" with Jane Fonda in 2007. Her pop music recording career, boosted by her movie roles, has floundered in the past year. Her last album was released in 2005. CNN's Irving Last contributed to this report.

# Los Angeles: The City of Angels

Los Angeles, California, stands as one of the most iconic and influential cities in the United States. Known affectionately as "the City of Angels," a translation of its Spanish name, Los Angeles has grown from a small Spanish settlement into a sprawling metropolis that shapes global culture, entertainment, and innovation.

## A Brief History

Founded in 1781 as "El Pueblo de Nuestra Señora la Reina de los Ángeles," the city's roots trace back to Spanish colonial rule. After Mexico gained independence, the area became part of Mexican territory before being ceded to the United States following the Mexican-American War in 1848. The discovery of oil and the arrival of the railroad in the late 19th century spurred rapid growth, setting the stage for the city's transformation into a major American metropolis.

## Entertainment Capital of the World

Perhaps no industry is more synonymous with Los Angeles than entertainment. Hollywood, a neighborhood within the city, has served as the epicenter of the American film industry since the early 20th century. Major studios like Warner Bros., Paramount Pictures, and Universal Studios call the area home, drawing aspiring actors, directors, and creatives from around the world. The iconic Hollywood Sign, perched in the hills overlooking the city, remains a global symbol of dreams and ambition.

## Geography and Climate

Situated in Southern California, Los Angeles enjoys a Mediterranean climate characterized by warm, dry summers and mild winters. The city is bordered by the Pacific Ocean to the west and surrounded by mountain ranges, creating a diverse landscape that includes beaches, urban sprawl, and natural wilderness areas within close proximity to one another.

## Cultural Diversity

Los Angeles is renowned for its remarkable diversity, home to communities from virtually every corner of the globe. This multicultural fabric is reflected in neighborhoods like Koreatown, Little Tokyo, Chinatown, and Boyle Heights, each offering unique cultural experiences, cuisine, and traditions. This diversity has made Los Angeles a vibrant hub for culinary innovation and cultural exchange.

## Economic Powerhouse

Beyond entertainment, Los Angeles boasts a diverse economy encompassing technology, fashion, international trade, and aerospace industries. The Port of Los Angeles ranks among the busiest in the nation, facilitating significant international commerce. Silicon Beach, a nickname for the coastal area housing numerous tech startups, has emerged as a growing rival to Silicon Valley.

## Conclusion

Los Angeles, California, embodies the American dream in many ways—a place where diverse cultures converge, industries flourish, and countless individuals arrive seeking opportunity and reinvention. Its unique blend of natural beauty, economic vitality, and cultural richness continues to cement its status as one of the world's great cities.
